purpose: ADR-067 (02.10.2026): a topic that starts with only a greeting is answered without a search plan, an embedding or a search. On 02.10 "tere" took 20.8 s right after a restart and about 10 s on a warm server, after a plan with no queries, a search of the whole corpus and a rerank of 12 500 tokens. A greeting with a request in it, and the question after a greeting, take the whole route.

expectation_help.greeting: true: the turn took the greeting route (no plan, no search); false: it took the whole route
expectation_help.must / must_not: regular expressions on the visible answer text. A greeting's answer greets back and does not talk about missing sources.

scenarios.title: Ingliskeelne tervitus saab ingliskeelse vastuse
scenarios.source: the answer follows the language the user wrote in

must: hello|hi\b|how can i help|how may i help

scenarios.title: Tervitus koos küsimusega läheb täisrada
scenarios.source: anything more than a greeting is a request

turns.text: Tere! Mul on suured võlad, kes mind aitab?

scenarios.title: Küsimus pärast tervitust
scenarios.source: the greeting turn is an ordinary saved turn; the next message continues the topic
